caption: The drawing depicts a single, horizontally oriented, ornate object resembling a weather vane or decorative metalwork. The object is rendered in grayscale, with shading that gives it a metallic appearance. On the left end, there is a sculpted human hand with an extended index finger pointing to the left; the details of the fingers and fingernails are visible. The central portion of the object is symmetrical along a horizontal axis, with scrolling, leaf-like flourishes extending from the middle toward both ends. The right end of the object features a design consisting of curved, crescent shapes and an oval at its center. The background is a plain, off-white or beige, free of additional elements. There is a signature in the lower left corner, reading "Helen Hobart."
title: Weather Vane - Scroll with Index
